text.text: I will also gather all nations, and will bring them down into the valley of Jehoshaphat, and will plead with them there for my people and for my heritage Israel, whom they have scattered among the nations, and parted my land.
The Lord standeth up to plead, and standeth to judge the people.
For by fire and by his sword will the Lord plead with all flesh: and the slain of the Lord shall be many.
Like as I pleaded with your fathers in the wilderness of the land of Egypt, so will I plead with you, saith the Lord God.
